claims.text: Immune response modifier: induces local cytokines and a brisk inflammatory reaction
claims.quote: Imiquimod is an immune response modifier that stimulates local cytokine induction, resulting in a brisk local inflammatory reaction.

claims.text: Imiquimod and fluorouracil have moderate-quality evidence for cSCC in situ but are not FDA-approved for it
claims.quote: Moderate-quality evidence supports the use of topical options (i.e., imiquimod, and fluorouracil) for the treatment of CSCC in situ but are not approved by the FDA.
